affectedPublicSurfaces: Supabase PostgREST exposure of every table in the public schema
unauthenticated public Demo read path (must remain working)
all authenticated /v1 reads and writes (must remain working)

candidateVerificationJourney.restrictedRoute: candidate database in CI plus a loopback candidate app; assert privilege state via system catalogs and confirm every product read path still succeeds

journeys.name: boundary-actually-closed
journeys.entryUrl: candidate database: connect as anon and as authenticated
assertions: no table outside the gold allowlist is selectable
a newly created table in public is not selectable without explicit grant

htmlRoutes: not-applicable: backend/config change with no HTML route or static asset

migrationCompatibility.notes: Grants and default privileges only — no table, column, or data changes. Stable and candidate share one database, so the privilege change applies to both at once: it must therefore be verified to be a no-op for the backend's own connection BEFORE cutover. Reversible via the migration's downgrade.

rollbackAssertion.postCutoverFailureBehavior: run the migration downgrade to restore prior grants; note this re-opens the boundary, so it is an availability remedy only and must be followed by a fix-forward

acceptanceCommands: alembic upgrade head && alembic downgrade -1 && alembic upgrade head
doNotInfer: Do not add or repair per-table RLS policies in this slice — ADR-061 defers that to 3.5-C
Do not grant USAGE on gold to anon as a convenience; the allowlist is explicit and narrow
Do not assume the anon/authenticated roles exist in every environment — reuse the existing role-existence guard from migration 021
Do not treat a passing CI assertion as proof the hosted project's Data API is off
